description: Detect knowledge gaps between topic clusters. Returns gap severity, isolated nodes, and suggested topics to bridge gaps. Result cached 6h (set forceRefresh=true to recompute).

forceRefresh.description: Bypass cache and recompute (expensive: 30s+ on large vaults). Default false.

minSeverity.description: Minimum gap severity to include: high, medium, or low

name: detect-gaps
